generation.initialPrompt:
Create ONE production game sprite atlas, not a concept illustration. Use the attached old traveler sheet ONLY for character identity (cream hood, dusty blue short cape, brown leather clothes, short steel sword in right hand, small round wooden shield on left arm). Completely redraw as compact genuine low-resolution pixel art: chunky clean pixel clusters, 3-4 flat shades per material, strong dark selective outline, large head and compact limbs, no painterly rendering or smooth shading. Original dark-fantasy isometric sprite visual language like small professional monster sprite packs. Do not reproduce another artist's exact character.

EXACT OUTPUT: transparent RGBA PNG canvas 1024 pixels wide by 640 pixels high, exactly 8 columns and 5 rows, exactly 128x128 pixels per cell. No gutters, no grid lines, no labels, no extra margins, do not crop the canvas. Each cell is an independent native 128px frame, character body approx 68px high with empty margins. Pixel edges must be hard native pixel steps, no anti-aliasing, no soft alpha, no blur, no gradients. Draw at native pixels, do not paint large and downsample. Identical character size throughout. Standing ground/root anchor at local (64,108) in every frame; fixed elevated three-quarter game camera, light from upper left. Keep sword, shield, cape and the whole body inside each cell, minimum 8px margin to all cell edges. NO cast shadows, backdrop, effects, text, borders, watermark, guide lines or checkerboard.

EXACT ROW ORDER, all 40 cells occupied, left to right:
Row0: 8 idle facing directions: south, south-east, east, north-east, north, north-west, west, south-west. Same neutral ready pose, no duplicated direction.
Row1: cells0-3 four-frame EAST walk loop (left foot forward, passing, right foot forward, passing); cells4-7 four-frame WEST walk loop. Real alternating legs and counter-swing, cape slight sway, root stays in place.
Row2: cells0-3 four-frame EAST sword attack (ready anticipation, raised windup, decisive outward strike, recovery); cells4-7 corresponding WEST sword attack. Sword and shield remain anatomically on correct arms; no glowing slash or trail.
Row3: cells0-3 four-frame EAST hit reaction (impact recoils torso, strongest backward bend, regaining footing, ready); cells4-7 WEST hit reaction. Feet remain fixed, outfit never changes.
Row4: cells0-3 four-frame EAST death (buckling knees, falling, body lands, fully prone still); cells4-7 WEST death. Body lies in same cell with sword and shield, no blood, no disappearance. Final death frame stays low on the ground.

CRITICAL: equal regular cell centers x=64,192,320,448,576,704,832,960. Each row begins at y=0,128,256,384,512. Never spill pixels into a neighboring cell. This image will be sliced by those exact mathematical cells. Return only the atlas PNG with real alpha.
